description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [High Quick Cast 3], grants [Awoken Sovereign] and [Beloved Homeland Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Sovereign
description.text: Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Magical Blink 1] to all allies after using two Support abilities

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Magical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Beloved Homeland Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Beloved Homeland and Lost Nation after using a Support ability

description.name: Beloved Homeland
description.text: Four single ranged hybrid attacks (0.28 or 1.00 each), grants [PHY +30% Boost 1] or [Magical +30% Boost 1] to all allies, 100% hit rate

description.name: Lost Nation
description.text: Four single ranged hybrid attacks (0.28 or 1.00 each), causes [ATK and DEF -50% (15s)]/[MAG and RES -50% (15s)] after 1/2+2n uses, 100% hit rate
